acceptance: The Gateway stream suite has zero setup failures.
The shipped desktop Link composition starts a real Host and reaches pairing, Session list, Remote events, and the Remote Approval switch.
The test uses a temporary credential document and does not read or write the user's Harness home.
The Connection service remains available without a WebServer and binds the HTTP carrier when the optional service is present or appears later.
knownLimitations: The initial pnpm run build:official invocation completed Host and Client builds but its Web child could not resolve the relative host-workaround preload; pnpm run build:web passed with the same preload resolved to an absolute path. G1-CI will run the complete official aggregate with the absolute path.
